description: This file defines the Git::SVN::Log package, implementing SVN log parsing, display, and blame functionalities with integration to Git commands.

classes.name: Git::SVN::Log
classes.description: Package implementing SVN log parsing, display, and blame functionalities within Git integration.

methods.name: cmt_showable
methods.description: Determines if a commit is showable based on its revision and message content.

methods.name: log_use_color
methods.description: Checks if color should be used in logs based on configuration.

methods.name: git_svn_log_cmd
methods.description: Constructs the git svn log command with appropriate options based on revision range and arguments.

methods.name: config_pager
methods.description: Configures the pager program for log output.

methods.name: run_pager
methods.description: Executes the pager program to display output.

methods.name: format_svn_date
methods.description: Formats a timestamp into SVN date string with timezone offset.

methods.name: parse_git_date
methods.description: Parses a git date string with timezone into a timestamp.

methods.name: tz_to_s_offset
methods.description: Converts timezone string to seconds offset.

methods.name: get_author_info
methods.description: Extracts and stores author information from commit data.

methods.name: process_commit
methods.description: Processes and displays commit information based on revision range filters.

methods.name: show_commit
methods.description: Displays commit information in either one-line or detailed format.

methods.name: show_commit_changed_paths
methods.description: Displays changed paths of a commit.

methods.name: cmd_show_log
methods.description: Handles the 'show log' command, parsing git log output and displaying commits.

methods.name: cmd_blame
methods.description: Handles the 'blame' command, displaying blame information for a file.
